profile.headline: Software Engineer at Ford Motor Company
profile.summary: I am a Software Engineer looking to change the world (cliché). Maybe not the world but the communities I live and work in. As an IT professional with 10+ years of experience, I know technology is what will bridge the gap between organizations and diverse communities. I want to be there for the ride. Let's take on this journey together. Email me at kareemdjames@gmail.com.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Wrote production quality code for internal API layer that allows third parties to securely integrate with and send commands to Ford and Lincoln vehicles.
• Designed and maintained middleware to support Amazon's in-car delivery service. 
• Aggregate data collection and testing through cross-team collaborations to implement and support modern vehicle features.
• Constructed Amazon Alexa Skills and Google Actions to support electric vehicle features.
• Led implementation of paired programming practices into team workflow, resulting in organized, documented, and accountable work.

positions.title: BlackTruss, Inc.
positions.description:
• Met client hardware and software needs by offering professional consultations and services to small businesses.
• Recommend architectural improvements, design solutions, and integration solutions.
• Provided software/OS installation, configuration, file migration, and troubleshooting for a medical billing firm.
• Developed and implemented landing pages with contact forms and other back end features.
• Run diagnostic tests to isolate system problems and make recommendations for solutions.
• Administration and Troubleshooting of DNS, DHCP, and Terminal Server.
• Installed and upgraded PC hardware (RAM, Hard drives, and CD-ROM/ DVD's).
• Installed and supported Windows Desktops in a workgroup or Active Directory domain environments.
• Created and administered user accounts/network access utilizing Active Directory.

positions.title: B2B Account Manager
positions.description:
• Prospected, acquired and maintained newly acquired business through relationship sales approach. 
• Engaged with clients to understand their business issues and provided solutions. 
• Met a variety of goals and quotas on a bi-weekly basis, including but not limited to making a predetermined amount of prospecting or "cold calls” each day. 
• Processed phone orders, generating RFQ's, closing sales and then maintaining said account. 
• Supported and increased a portfolio account base through proper balance of account prospecting and maintenance.

positions.title: Desktop Support
positions.description:
• Credited with defining and documenting policies, procedures, and best practices for hardware/software inventory, installations, configuration, and maintenance.
• Led 6 team members in successful deployment and rollout of Win XP Workstations for 350+ users at Standard & Poor’s. Documented rollout processes, technical issues; and provided post-rollout support.
• Installed and configured Pass Connect with Cisco VPN client on Laptops for remote access.
• Installed, configured, and supported enterprise applications such as Microsoft Office 2003, Adobe Professional, Adobe CS2, Bloomberg, Avistar, and in-house proprietary applications for USB Investment Bank.
• Analyzed and resolved multiple connectivity issues involving TCP/IP, HP Jet Direct and wireless cards.

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description:
Technical Support Specialist, Washington Group				
• On-site support of corporate office and 100+ users within Windows XP/Server 2003 Active Directory environment. 
• Performed break-fix support, PC/laptop/printer upgrade and repair, and disaster recovery.
• Installed, configured, and supported MS Outlook in Exchange Server environment; as well as enterprise applications including Microsoft Office 2003, Adobe Professional, and in-house applications. 
• Sharpened information security by orchestrating a successful upgrade of 100 users to Symantec 9.1.

Technical Support Specialist, ESPN						
• Provided remote and on-site support of corporate offices in Windows XP/Server 2003 Active Directory environment. 
• Performed basic Bes Server administration support for Blackberries devices, activation, and maintenance of mobile devices (cell phones, wireless, and air cards). 
• Maintained accurate inventory of laptops, PCs, printers, and mobile devices via Remedy.
• Administered appropriate tools, diagnostic procedures, preventive maintenance, and troubleshooting techniques for PC components, desktops, laptops, networks, printers, and peripherals.
 
PC/MAC Technician, Grey Global Group						
• Expedited daily operations through troubleshooting and resolution of technical issues surrounding multiple software programs/installations, network connectivity, and hardware/ peripherals. 
• Installed and upgraded PC/MAC hardware components such as Hard Drives, NIC Cards, Video Cards, Power Supplies, and other PC related accessories.
• Key contributor to Help Desk operations, as well as creation, maintenance, and version control of Workstation/Laptop images utilizing Symantec Ghost, and Acronis True Image Software.
• Interfaced with the Purchasing Department to track inventory and assist in cost-effective procurement of PC components, accessories and software.

projects.title: Focus Group App (React, React-Router, Express, PostgreSQL)
projects.description:
• Project lead to build an app to connect businesses with users who wish to participate in targeted information gathering (eg: surveys) for monetary compensation. 
• Delegated sections within a 3 person group to ensure project completion from start to finish. 
• Collaborated with team to build a custom Express API.

projects.title: Better Barber (React, React-Router, React-Bulma, Firebase)
projects.description:
• Independently designed a mobile first app, which enables customers to locate a nearby barbershop and join an available barbers queue.
• Used Google Maps API to match customer location to nearest barbershop.  
• Researched app effectiveness through one-on-one exchange with barbers.
